scopeAmendments: Pointer-open menus close outside their title/flyout; closed lists are explicitly hidden and inert
Command labels and shortcuts use distinct left/right columns; disabled rows are visibly subdued
Picker ownership is separate from pending PDF adoption and command availability
Correct two confirmed recents error-reporting misclassifications
Correct native cancellation DTO serialization preventing session release

nativeCapacity.cause: CancelBarrier emitted barrier_id but the renderer consumed barrierId, preventing close_pdf_session from receiving its required barrier
nativeCapacity.before: Fresh packaged process opened and closed the small fixture eight times; the ninth open failed with This PDF exceeds reader resource limits
nativeCapacity.redTest: Serialized JSON was {barrier_id: 1}, not the required {barrierId: 1}
nativeCapacity.fix: Producer uses serde camelCase; capacity limits and ownership rules are unchanged
nativeCapacity.after: After upstream synchronization, 22 packaged open/close operations passed in one process: five CLI/Recent pairs followed by twelve additional consecutive CLI cycles
nativeCapacity.regression: src-tauri/tests/cp4_open_request.rs::serialized_cancel_barrier_releases_capacity_across_repeated_renderer_closes crosses JSON serialization and checks empty native sessions plus zero workspace sessions after each of twelve cycles

diagnosedDefects.menuDuringAdoption: nativeOpenPending spans the entire admission/adoption/ack epoch. The menu now blocks only the actual open_pdf_dialog invocation; per-command availability still uses pending state
diagnosedDefects.recentsReporting: Recent subscription/decode faults no longer overwrite active PDF status with a PDF-open error; recent invocation rejection retains its specific fallback
diagnosedDefects.pickerRejections: Known SELECTION_REJECTED reasons such as SESSION_CAPACITY and MISSING_FILE now retain their specific message instead of becoming a generic PDF-open error
diagnosedDefects.stackedFlyouts: The user's stacked-menu screenshot was not reproduced in the short original-build native baseline pass. Corrected ownership explicitly synchronizes hidden/inert/display state and repeated actual native pointer cycles verify all closed lists are absent
diagnosedDefects.wrappedTransit: Flyouts attach directly below the selected title. With wrapped titles, covering lower-row titles is resolved by pointer-out close or keyboard section switching rather than requiring transit across another title

browser.matrix: 480x360 and 1040x760 CSS viewports; DPR 1/1.25/1.5/2; 100/200 percent root text; seven themes; forced colors off/on
checks: Continuous pointer transit and outside close

packagedWindows.isolation: Separate QA bundle identifier, application state and explicit WebView2 data directory; no user PDFs or state edited
packagedWindows.postUpstreamValidation: All local gates, the browser matrix, and 22 packaged open/close operations in one process were rerun after merging origin/main 0687b89d4b5e56cfc13becd99ea86d3bf97839c9
checks: Actual title-to-flyout and outside pointer movement
Summary Enter, section arrows and Escape
Real PDF canvases on CLI and Recent opens

packagedWindows.windowSizing: Native client resize requests 624x468 and 480x360; observed WebView2 devicePixelRatio approximately 1.3. These are not claims of a complete OS DPI matrix

remainingNativeAcceptance: Actual Windows 100/125/150/200 percent DPI and 200 percent text settings
Two-window independence and inactive-window first click
Native picker cancellation/selection automation and titlebar/snap/system-key audit
warningsNotSuppressed: Installed Node/npm differ from pinned engine

limitations: The capacity leak and reporting defects are proven and repaired. This does not establish that every possible PDF-open failure or the exact stacked-pixel screenshot has the same cause. Native smoke evidence does not replace the remaining manual acceptance.
